'''Geneviève Almouzni''' (born 1960) is a French [[biologist]], a specialist in [[epigenetics]] and director of the [[Curie Institute (Paris)|Curie Institute]]'s research centre.<ref>« Geneviève Almouzni devient directrice du Centre de Recherche de l’Institut Curie », ''Journal des femmes'', 5 septembre 2013 (lire en ligne)</ref>

== Biography ==
Geneviève Almouzni was born in [[Algeria]] and studied at the [[École normale supérieure de Fontenay-aux-Roses]] from 1980 to 1985. In 1988, she defended a thesis in [[microbiology]] at the [[Pierre and Marie Curie University|Université Pierre-et-Marie-Curie]] on the use of a system derived from xenope eggs to study [[DNA]] [[chromatin]] replication and assembly under the supervision of Marcel Méchali.<ref>{{Cite thesis|url=http://www.theses.fr/1988PA066018|title=Utilisation d'un systeme derive d'oeufs de xenope pour etudier la replication et l'assemblage en chromatine de l'adn|first=Geneviève|last=Almouzni|date=January 1, 1988|publisher=Paris 6 |via=www.theses.fr}}</ref>

From 1988 to 1989 and 1991 to 1993, she went to the United States to work as a post-doc in the research centre of the [[National Institutes of Health]] in [[Bethesda, Maryland|Bethesda]], in the laboratory of Professor [[Alan Wolffe]].She has been a research director at the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]] since January 2000.{{citation needed|date=November 2019}}

In 2013, she took over the direction of research at the Institut Curie and became the third woman to hold this position after [[Marie Curie]] and [[Irène Joliot-Curie]].<ref>« Geneviève Almouzni, l'art de la science », ''La Tribune'', 8 mars 2014 (lire en ligne)</ref> She served on the Life Sciences jury for the [[Infosys Prize]] in 2013. She was Chair of EU-LIFE (2018-2019), the alliance of research institutes advocating for excellent research in Europe.<ref>{{Cite web |title=GENEVIEVE ALMOUZNI |url=https://institut-curie.org/personne/genevieve-almouzni |access-date=9 March 2022 |website=Institut Curie}}</ref> Geneviève Almouzni is also a member of the editorial board of Cell magazine.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cell.com/cell/editorial-board|title=Editorial Board: Cell|website=www.cell.com}}</ref>

== Scientific work ==
Her research focuses on [[cancer]] prevention, including the role of certain [[protein]]s in tumor development.{{citation needed|date=November 2019}}
Geneviève Almouzni studies the transmission of genetic and epigenetic information in [[Eukaryote|eukaryotic cells]], particularly through chromatin assembly mechanisms, and the impact of potential errors at this level of regulation, particularly on cancer.<ref>{{cite web|title=Rencontre avec Geneviève Almouzni|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Seances-publiques/5a7-genevieve-almouzni-2018.html|date=}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==

* 2000 [[CNRS Silver Medal|CNRS silver medal]]{{citation needed|date=November 2019}}
* 2011 Chevalier of the [[Legion of Honour|Légion d'Honneur]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Geneviève Almouzni |url=https://vertigo.ircam.fr/person/genevieve-almouzni/ |website=vertigo.ircam.fr |accessdate=15 November 2019 |language=en }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
* 2013 [[FEBS]]/[[European Molecular Biology Organization|EMBO]] [[FEBS/EMBO Women in Science Award|Women in Science Award]]<ref name=":02">{{cite web|title=Women in Science Award|url=http://www.embo.org/funding-awards/women-in-science-award|date=20 August 2020}}</ref> for her research work in the field of epigenetics, in particular the role of [[histone]]s and chromatin in controlling gene activity
* 2013 elected to the American Association for the Advancement of Science<ref>{{cite web|title=AAAS Council Elects 388 New AAAS Fellows|url=http://www.aaas.org/news/aaas-council-elects-388-new-aaas-fellows|date=}}</ref>
* 2013 elected to the [[French Academy of Sciences|French Academy of sciences]] since December 10, 2013<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-A/genevieve-almouzni.html|date=}}</ref>
* 2016 Officier of the Légion d'Honneur<ref>{{cite web|title=Décret du 13 mai 2016 portant élévation aux dignités de grand'croix et de grand officier|url=http://www.legiondhonneur.fr/sites/default/files/promotion/onm20160515.pdf|website=Journal Officiel|date=15 May 2016}}</ref>
